metadata.title: Doh Khleh | Khasi Style Minced Pork Salad
metadata.description:
Doh Khleh is a mainstay in Khasi cuisine. It is a classic meat salad made of steamed or boiled pork meat with sliced onions and ginger. 

There is another dish which is similar but made of pigs brain and is called 'Doh Khlieh'.

This particular dish is made with meat from around the head or spinal cord region and is steamed or boiled and then mixed with finely chopped onions and garlic.
